description: Chargers on a drive: "fast chargers on my drive from Denver to Salt Lake City", "where can I charge between Chicago and Omaha?", "Tesla chargers on I-80 from Reno to Sacramento". Send from and to (U.S. place names, or "lat,lng"), with via for stops in between; or waypoints in driving order, each {place} or {lat, lng} (2 to 10 places, or up to 100 points: add one every 50 to 100 miles). With place names the route follows roads and each station gets route_mile, its miles from the start. Optional speed (dcfc for long drives), min_power_kw, connector, network and corridor_miles. Each station comes with its network, connector types, power in kW, DC fast and Level 2 port counts, price where known, the date its details were last confirmed and its ChargingNear.me page link (url), plus live port availability where a live reading exists (included for clients with a commercial API key). With place names, results are sorted by route_mile; with points, by segment in driving order, then by distance from the segment's midpoint.

available_now.description: Only stations showing a free port in a live reading under 15 minutes old. Live availability is available only to clients with a commercial API key; without one, this filter is ignored and the answer lists it under ignored_filters.

connector.description: Plug type, case-insensitive: NACS (Tesla), CCS, CHAdeMO or J1772, or a raw NREL code (TESLA, J1772COMBO, CHADEMO). Comma-separate to match any.

corridor_miles.description: Width of search corridor in miles from route (default 5, max 25)

from.description: Where the drive starts: a U.S. city, address or business name ("Denver, CO"), or "lat,lng"

limit_per_waypoint.description: Max stations per waypoint segment (default 5, max 10)

min_power_kw.description: Minimum charger power in kW (e.g. 50, 150, 250). 150 and up only match stations with a known wattage.

network.description: Network name contains, e.g. Tesla, Electrify America, ChargePoint

speed.description: Charging level: dcfc (DC fast), level2 or level1

to.description: Where the drive ends, like from ("Salt Lake City, UT")

via.description: Stops in between, in driving order, like from (optional)

waypoints.description: Instead of from and to: every stop in driving order, each {place} or {lat, lng}

place.description: A U.S. city, address or business name, e.g. "Denver, CO"

name: find_stations_on_route
title: Stations along a route
